title: Zero-Dimensional Quadratic Systems
statement: Let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations over $mathbb{F}_2$ in zero variables, and let $w$ be the unique assignment on the empty set of variables. Then $w$ satisfies every equation in $L$ if and only if every equation in $L$ has right-hand side $0$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of quadratic equations in zero variables
An assignment on the empty variable set
